task.title: Build a Zapier automation that posts real-time booking alerts to Slack from a Google Sheet
task.summary: For the business 'Salt & Stone Coastal Tours', set up an end-to-end no-code automation so that whenever a new booking is added to a Google Sheet, a formatted alert is posted to a Slack channel for the dock crew. The user recreates a bookings spreadsheet in Google Sheets from a local starter file, creates/uses a Slack channel (#crew-alerts), builds and publishes a Zapier Zap (Google Sheets 'New Spreadsheet Row' -> Slack 'Send Channel Message'), then validates it by adding booking rows and confirming each one triggers a successful Slack message.
task.goal: A published Zap that, for every new row in the 'Salt and Stone Booking' Google Sheet, sends a clearly formatted booking alert to the Slack #crew-alerts channel.
applications: WPS Office Spreadsheets (local source data: salt_stone_bookings_starter)
steps: Read the task brief in the Postwork app.
Open the local starter spreadsheet 'salt_stone_bookings_starter' in WPS Office to see the source booking data and column schema.
In Chrome, open Google Sheets and create a new spreadsheet titled 'Salt and Stone Booking'.
Add the column headers (Booking_ID, Guest_Name, Experience_Type, Boat_Name, Guest_Count, Start_Time) and enter the first booking row.
Open Slack and ensure a #crew-alerts channel exists for the dock crew.
Open Zapier and create a Zap named 'Salt and Stone Zap'.
Configure the trigger: Google Sheets -> 'New Spreadsheet Row', connect the Google account (OAuth) and select the 'Salt and Stone Booking' spreadsheet/worksheet.

Configure the action: Slack -> 'Send Channel Message', connect Slack (OAuth), choose channel #crew-alerts, and compose a 'New Booking Alert' message mapping booking fields (Guest Name, Group Size, Experience Type, Boat/Vessel, Start Time) plus the line 'Please prepare the boat and crew accordingly'. Send as bot.
Validate end-to-end by adding the remaining booking rows to the Google Sheet and confirming the Zap run history shows successful runs that posted messages to Slack.
success_criteria: A Google Sheet named 'Salt and Stone Booking' exists containing the booking columns and rows.
A Slack channel named #crew-alerts exists in the workspace.
A Zap exists and is PUBLISHED with trigger = Google Sheets 'New Spreadsheet Row' on that sheet and action = Slack 'Send Channel Message' to #crew-alerts.
The action message contains a 'New Booking Alert' with the booking details mapped from the trigger row.
Adding a new row to the sheet produces a successful Zap run that posts the alert to #crew-alerts (verified in Zap run history / Slack channel).

initial_state.narrative: Every RL episode resets to a Windows desktop with the Postwork task-harness in the foreground showing the project brief 'Real-time Booking Alerts for Salt & Stone Coastal Tours'. A local starter spreadsheet of 15 bookings (the source-of-truth data) is available in WPS Office / on disk. The user is already signed in to the accounts required to complete the task (Google, Slack, Zapier), but NOTHING has been built yet: no Google Sheet, no Slack channel, and no Zap exist at t=0. The agent must produce all of those from the starter data and the brief.
initial_state.starting_screen: Postwork app, 'Current Project - Business Automation', titled 'Real-time Booking Alerts for Salt & Stone Coastal Tours', with a 'Currently Recording' panel (Session ID 006897b3-9b62-4c88-a0ef-0df904d9d46d). Windows taskbar shows Chrome, WPS Office, File Explorer, and a search box. Resolution 1920x1080.
initial_state.task_brief_text: Salt & Stone Coastal Tours is a boutique operator offering private fishing charters and sunset [tours/rentals]. The founder is currently missing urgent booking details because notifications are buried in a busy email inbox, leading to delays in boat preparation. They need a straightforward [no-code] automation to funnel new booking data directly into a Slack channel for the dock crew. (A collapsed 'Requirements' section is present but was not expanded in the recording.)

preconditions: User is signed in to Google, Slack (workspace main-dyd9530), and Zapier before the episode starts.
The 'salt_stone_bookings_starter' file is present locally and openable in WPS Office.
No 'Salt and Stone Booking' Google Sheet exists yet.
No 'Salt and Stone Zap' exists yet in Zapier.
Internet access to docs.google.com, slack.com, and zapier.com is available.
reset_instructions: Provision a Windows VM at 1920x1080 with Chrome, WPS Office, and File Explorer.
Place the starter spreadsheet (seed_data above) on disk as 'salt_stone_bookings_starter.xlsx'.
Pre-authenticate the browser sessions / store OAuth tokens for the Google, Slack, and Zapier test accounts.
Ensure the Google Drive contains NO sheet named 'Salt and Stone Booking', the Zapier account has NO Zap named 'Salt and Stone Zap', and (optionally) the Slack workspace has NO #crew-alerts channel.
Display the task brief (Postwork) or pass it to the agent as the instruction.
Optionally seed Slack with the dock-crew members so the channel has an audience.
